title: visual-intent-v1
description: A request to the engine's resolveIntent: what a piece has to do for its reader, where it will be seen and what it has to say. Mirrors VisualIntentV1 in packages/core/src/intent-v1.ts. `purpose` may be left out only when `prompt` is given, and the answer then carries the purposes and tools so the calling agent can read its own user's words, choose a purpose and call again. Nothing here reads meaning from text. parseVisualIntent also bounds nesting, total size and duplicate surfaces.

purpose.description: What the piece does for its reader.

prompt.description: The words the user first said to the agent. Carried and digested, and never read for meaning. Past the limit it is refused, not cut.

recordPrompt.description: Asks a render to record the prompt's own words in the file's credential. By default a fingerprint is recorded. A run's own answer wins.

occasion.description: Free text. Recorded, and read by nothing that decides.

audience.description: Free text. Recorded, and read by nothing that decides.

region.description: Free text. Recorded, and read by nothing that decides.

language.description: A short language tag such as de or pt-BR. Selects where a tool offers that language.

content.description: Content by role. The `roles` section of schemas/canonical-inputs.json says what each one is.

surfaces.description: Where the piece will be seen. Required with a purpose.

prefer.description: Rank this tool first among the ones that fit each surface.

format.description: One output format. Must be one the chosen tool exports.
